- Objective WEBSITE_CLICKS, optimizing for link clicks, with automatic bidding.
- Placement: all of X on Twitter.
- Platform: iOS only.
- Locations: worldwide, excluding Russia and Belarus.

- Schedule: start 00:00 Feb 10 and end 23:59 Feb 14, Auckland time (NZDT, UTC+13).
